395: All of the territory of the incorporated city limits shall be subject to the terms of the curfew, unless otherwise specified in the resolution.
396: It shall be prohibited for any person, other than exempt individuals, to appear in public in the territory subject to the curfew, including but not limited to, streets, highways, alleys, sidewalks, vacant lots, parks, public buildings or any other public places in all or a delineated part of incorporated city limits during the stated hours of the curfew.
399:
Any building contractor required by this division to pay a registration fee who engages in business without first registering and receiving a registration certification from the city as required shall be in violation of this article. Violation of this article, upon conviction, shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed $1,000.00 per violation and imprisonment not to exceed 60 days. Each day a building contractor does business in the city without complying with this article shall constitute a separate offense.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 5)
400:
No person, firm, partnership, corporation or other entity shall engage in, undertake or carry on any business in whole or in part within the city, consisting of or relating to building, constructing, repairing, renovating or making improvements to real property including dwellings, homes, buildings, structures, or fixtures attached thereto without having registered the name of the business with the governing authority of the city and having paid fees as provided by this article.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 1)
401:
All building contractors doing business or proposing to do business in the incorporated areas of the city during a state of emergency or the subsequent recovery period shall register and file applications with the clerk of the governing authority of the city or such other person designated by the governing authority at the city hall or such other place or places designated by the city. The building contractor shall, under oath, provide the city council with a statement describing the general nature of the business to be conducted and give true and correct information as may be called for on the registration form, application or certificate provided by the city.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 3)
402:
Building contractor registration fees are as established by the city council. Registration fees shall be paid in full at the time of issuance of the registration certification.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 4)
403:
Each certification issued under this article is granted to, and shall be accepted by, the building contractor under the condition that the same is not transferable and after issuance no such certification shall be transferred by the city or the building contractor to another individual or entity.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 6)
404:
Each certification issued hereunder shall be posted conspicuously by the building contractor in the place of business of the building contractor or shall be carried on his person or vehicle used in such business. Such certification shall be exhibited to any authorized enforcement officer when so requested.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 7)
405:
Each certification granted under this article is a mere permit to engage in the business only so long as said business is conducted in a lawful manner. The city council hereby reserves the right to revoke or suspend any certification granted hereunder if the building contractor, or the building contractor's agent or employee acting within the scope of his employment, violates this article or any other city, county, state or federal law. If after issuance of a certification, the city desires to revoke such certification, written notice thereof shall be given to the building contractor, which notice shall specify the violation with which the building contractor is charged and a date, time and place at which a hearing shall be held with regard to the violation. The building contractor shall have an opportunity to be heard at such hearing, and shall have the right to be represented by counsel and to introduce and submit evidence in opposition to such revocation.
(Ord. of 5-5-2007, § 8)
